description: Compliance rules for legal documents (contracts, leases, agreements)

rules.name: Termination Clause
rules.description: Contract must define termination conditions and notice period

rules.name: Security Deposit Terms
rules.description: Security deposit amount and refund terms must be clear

rules.name: Deposit-to-Rent Ratio
rules.description: Security deposit should not exceed 3 months rent

rules.name: Rent Reasonableness Check
rules.description: Monthly rent should be within reasonable bounds

rules.name: Maintenance Responsibilities
rules.description: Contract must specify who handles repairs

rules.name: No Unilateral Changes
rules.description: Landlord cannot change terms without tenant consent

rules.name: GDPR Article 17 Compliance
rules.description: Check for right to erasure (if applicable)
rules.regulation_text: GDPR Article 17: Right to erasure - data subjects have the right to have personal data erased.

rules.name: Unconscionability Check
rules.description: Check for grossly unfair or one-sided terms
rules.regulation_text: Contracts should not contain terms that are grossly unfair or heavily one-sided in favor of one party.
